title: Birth of Prophet Muhammad
summary: Prophet Muhammad was born in the esteemed Quraysh tribe, known for their nobility, fifty to fifty-five days after the Year of the Elephant.
translation: The blessed birth of Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) occurred fifty or fifty-five days after the event known as the Year of the Elephant, on a Monday, the 8th of Rabi' al-Awwal, in the month of April, 570 CE, in the city of Makkah, at the house of Abu Talib during the early dawn. Though it is popularly believed that he was born on the 12th of Rabi' al-Awwal, the majority of hadith scholars and historians consider the 8th of Rabi' al-Awwal to be correct, and all subsequent dates and connections are based on this. The Prophet (peace be upon him) was born into a family that ruled over their people by virtue of their noble lineage, high morals, and generosity. Among the Arabs, his lineage and ancestry surpassed all others of his time. His family was known for bravery, generosity, and extraordinary memory, and eloquence in speech. Importantly, from Adam (peace be upon him) down to Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him), not one ancestor committed any wrongdoing, nor was his lineage marred by any improper birth. Referring to a verse in the Quran, the Prophet (peace be upon him) declared, 'There has come unto you a Messenger from among yourselves,’ and he explained 'I am the most honored among you by lineage, by maternal and paternal side, and in ancestry.' The Prophet (peace be upon him) stated that from Adam (peace be upon him) to him, all his ancestors were born from legitimate marriages.
